# Military Times

> Military Times is the leading independent news and information source for the U.S. military community, offering service member recognition, veteran resources, and comprehensive military news across all branches.

Military Times operates multiple publications including Army Times, Navy Times, Air Force Times, and Marine Corps Times, serving active duty personnel, veterans, and military families. The site provides news, career transition resources, awards recognition, and connections to military support organizations.

## Key Topics

- Army Times

## Awards & Recognition

- [Military Times Service Members of the Year](http://smoy.militarytimes.com): Annual awards program recognizing outstanding service members across all military branches
- [Hall of Valor: Medal of Honor, Silver Star, U.S. Military Awards](http://valor.militarytimes.com): Searchable database of Medal of Honor, Silver Star, and Bronze Star Medal recipients

## Career & Transition Resources

- [Education & Transition | Military Times](https://jobboard.militarytimes.com): Career resources for service members and veterans on education, jobs, and military transition

## Military Community Support

- [Pay It Forward](http://payitforward.militarytimes.com): Charity directory connecting military community with nonprofits like ADRA and Elizabeth Dole Foundation
- [Create an Obituary for Military Times](https://obits.militarytimes.com): Free obituary creation tool for honoring deceased military service members and veterans

## Military Reference & Information

- [Military Times: Installation Guide](http://installationguide.militarytimes.com): Directory of U.S. military installations including Fort Novosel, Maxwell AFB, and contact info

## Newsletters & Subscriptions

- [Newsletter Signup | Military Times](https://link.militarytimes.com/join/5b9/sign-up): Email subscription signup for Army Times, Navy Times, Air Force Times, Marine Corps Times
- [Newsletter Hub | Military Times](https://www.militarytimes.com/newsletters): Central newsletter hub offering Early Bird Brief and Daily News Roundup subscriptions
